finding.title: Reject empty fixed-request eligibility policy before replay invocation
finding.trigger: A zero-input missing-result bundle has a generic ConfigSpec eligibility_policy empty/whitespace string, updated result config_digest, and newly consistent receipt. Export/read admit it, since shape checks only the exact string type. Without an input scope no later equality check excludes it.
finding.observed: Controlled loader returns the unmodified accepted compute_trades, wrapped only with a call counter. Both empty and whitespace policies reach it once and return calculation_rejected.
finding.impact: A statically invalid fixed registry request is admitted to execution despite the planned configuration-mutation before-calculation gate. This does not produce an incorrect match or arbitrary execution, but breaches the zero-call request validation contract.
finding.requested_change: Require nonempty .strip() on the exact eligibility_policy string in shared shape admission, matching accepted bars._policy; add receipt-consistent zero-input negatives for export/read and forged-wrapper replay proving zero loader/calculator calls. Preserve valid missing-input replay and genuine post-invocation calculation_rejected reporting.
